offering_description.value: Produces distilled spirits and specialty wheat-based ingredients, selling bulk spirits, branded whiskey and food ingredients to beverage makers, food manufacturers and consumers.

primary_products.value: distilled spirits; wheat proteins; wheat starches; specialty food ingredients

customer_segment.value: B2B: beverage alcohol brand owners, spirits marketers, food and bakery manufacturers; B2C: consumers buying branded whiskey and spirits through retailers

end_markets.value: beverage alcohol; food and beverage; bakery

revenue_model.value: product sales: bulk spirits, branded spirits and ingredients sold to customers; service fees: contract bottling and custom distilling services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: distills and processes grain into spirits and ingredients, sold to brand owners and food makers; brand owner: markets its own whiskey and spirits brands, sold through distributors and retailers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with some export sales abroad

specialization.value: related lines: distilled spirits, specialty wheat proteins and starches, and specialty food ingredients sharing grain processing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: ingredients and bulk spirits sold directly to industrial customers; distributors / dealers: wholesale distributors that carry branded spirits to retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: alcohol production needs federal and state permits from TTB and state regulators, food ingredients follow FDA rules
